See the lord & tax rate info.

guard/31296-2.htm.text: Guard Cadmon: Ketra Orcs? Those mad creatures insist that Goddard belongs to them! But they are so formidable, we can't dismiss them. They've set up camp in the north of this village. Until recently, they seemed to think that they could take over... But the Varka Silenos have silenced their crazy a…

Q00011_SecretMeetingWithKetraOrcs/31296-.text: Guard Cadmon: Are you interested in the Ketra Orcs, stranger? Well, if you are, I can tell you an interesting story. Right now, the Ketra Orcs are hiring mercenaries! It's a great opportunity to get into their outpost under the pretext of delivering military supplies! Are you interested?
Guard Cadmon: I appreciate your interest, but the Ketra Orcs are some dangerous characters! You wouldn't stand a chance against them! (Only a character of level 74 or above may undertake this quest.)
Guard Cadmon: Find Trader Leon in the weapons and armor shop to deliver military supplies to the Ketra Orcs.

Q00012_SecretMeetingWithVarkaSilenos/312.text: Guard Cadmon: Are you interested in the Varka Silenos, stranger? Well, if you are, I know an interesting story. They've been hiring mercenaries lately! It's a great opportunity to gain access to their barracks on the pretext of smuggling weapons in!

Guard Cadmon: I appreciate your interest, but the Varkas aren't your average Silenos! They're some very rough characters! You wouldn't stand a chance! (Only a character of level 74 or above may undertake this quest.)
Guard Cadmon: Go to the weapons and armor shop, and tell Trader Helmut. Hurry up.

Q00011_SecretMeetingWithKetraOrcs/31296-.text: Guard Cadmon: Good! Find Trader Leon at the weapons and armor shop. He'll give you the details. Basically, you're delivering goods to them. The next step is up to you. You will either gain their trust or become their enemy!
